_purpose: Single source of truth for the Pranav PT website. A Next.js developer should be able to build the entire site using only the files in this /config folder. No content, color, spacing, or layout should be hardcoded anywhere in the codebase.

tech_stack.fonts: Google Fonts via next/font/google — Manrope (headings), Inter (body)

rendering_strategy.default: SSG — all pages are statically generated at build time
rendering_strategy.revalidation: Not needed for v1 (static JSON content)
rendering_strategy.note: Use generateStaticParams() for dynamic routes like /resources/[slug] and /learnings/[slug]

folder_structure_recommendation.app/resources/[slug]/page.tsx: Individual resource article — renders MD from content/resources/[slug].md
folder_structure_recommendation.components/sections/: One React component per section 'component' type (see component_registry below)
folder_structure_recommendation.components/ui/: Reusable primitives: Button, Card, Badge, Divider, SectionHeader
folder_structure_recommendation.config/: ALL content and design config lives here — never import from elsewhere
folder_structure_recommendation.content/resources/: Markdown (.md) files for individual resource articles

how_sections_work.pattern: Each page JSON has a 'sections' array. Each section has a 'component' field. The page file maps component names to React components and renders them in order.
how_sections_work.note: All section props come directly from the JSON. Components should be typed to match their JSON shape.

HeroFullscreen.description: Full viewport height (100vh) hero. Large headline, subheadline, body text, two CTAs. Left-aligned on desktop, centered on mobile. Gradient background from design-tokens.json gradients.hero.

AboutTeaser.description: Two-column split. Left: brief bio text + link to /about. Right: stats grid (4 stats). On mobile: stacked.

JourneyTeaser.description: Horizontal row of 4 milestone cards showing the arc of the journey. Each card has a date, a short title, and a tag. End of row has a 'See full journey' CTA linking to /about#journey.

CTABanner.description: Full-width banner with headline, optional subtitle, and 1-2 CTA buttons. Gradient background.

PageHero.description: Standard page hero — shorter than HeroFullscreen. Badge, headline, subheadline. Used at the top of all inner pages.

ProfileBlock.description: About Pranav section. Left: name, tagline, expertise tags, hobbies list. Right: stats row (4 stats). Below: expertise areas list.

Timeline.description: Vertical timeline. Each item has: date, title, description, optional tag (e.g. Milestone/Turning Point/Today), optional external link. Left-side dates on desktop, stacked on mobile. Anchor id: 'journey'.

ResourcesGrid.description: Filterable grid of resource cards. Each card: title, category tag, read_time, description, links to /resources/[slug]. Filter tabs by category rendered above the grid.

CourseGrid.description: Grid of course cards. Each card: thumbnail, title, tagline, duration, level, CTA button. Clicking card or CTA navigates to /learnings/[slug] for full detail.

CourseDetail.description: Full course detail: hero, what_you_learn bullets, day-by-day syllabus accordion/cards, pricing, CTA button that triggers payment flow. Reads from the course object in learnings.json.

ToolsGrid.description: Grid of tool cards. Each: thumbnail, title, tagline, built_with tags, CTA. Clicking navigates to /my-builts/[slug].

ToolDetail.description: Full tool detail: title, what it solves, features list, built_with tags, pricing, CTA. Reads from the tool object in my-builts.json.

SocialLinksBlock.description: Grid of social platform cards. Each: icon, platform name, handle/description, external link. Clean, minimal layout.

ContactForm.description: Simple form: Name, Email, Message, Submit. On submit, POST to /api/contact. Form config (fields, labels, validation rules) comes from talk-to-me.json.

payment_flow_note: The 'action: payment_flow' on CTA buttons in learnings.json and my-builts.json is a placeholder. Payment integration (Razorpay / Stripe) and post-payment email automation will be implemented in a later phase. For v1, the button can link to a Google Form or WhatsApp message.

content_update_workflow.add_resource: Add a new object to config/pages/resources.json categories[n].items array. Create the MD file at content/resources/[slug].md.
content_update_workflow.add_course: Add a new course object to config/pages/learnings.json courses array.
content_update_workflow.add_tool: Add a new tool object to config/pages/my-builts.json tools array.
content_update_workflow.change_colors: Edit config/design-tokens.json colors. Run 'npx tailwindcss' to regenerate.

important_rules: Never hardcode any color, spacing, or font value in a component — always reference design-tokens.json via Tailwind classes or CSS variables
Never hardcode any copy (text, labels, headings) in a component — always read from the JSON config
Every section component must accept and spread its full JSON section object as props
All external links must open in a new tab (target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer')
All images must have an alt attribute — sourced from the JSON
All pages must include the SEO meta from their _page_meta object using Next.js metadata API
Mobile-first: design for mobile layout first, then add desktop breakpoints
